about_short_description.short_description: Garment IO provides plug and play garment manufacturing management solution.

product.name: Garment IO Manufacturing Management SaaS
product.description: A cloud-based software platform that collects live data from production floors to monitor and analyze manufacturing operations in real time for labor-intensive industries.

product.name: Production Monitoring Module
product.description: A module that provides real-time monitoring and analysis of manufacturing operations across the entire production process.

product.name: Quality Audit Module
product.description: A module for conducting inline, end-of-line, and final quality audits to identify root causes of quality issues in manufacturing.

product.name: Maintenance Management Module
product.description: A module that tracks machine downtime, analyzes causes, and manages technician and maintenance staff performance.

product.name: Cost Analysis Module
product.description: A module that analyzes actual production costs down to the operation level to identify cost-saving opportunities and improve profitability.
